To: #announcements
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Linden Pantry charity stream — Nov 21

@everyone Quick heads up so nobody finds out the day of this time: I’m doing a 12-hour charity stream for Linden Community Pantry on Saturday, Nov 21, 10am–10pm. Goal is $600. Rook is matching the first $100, so early donations count double.

Donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz — it goes straight to the pantry, nothing taken off. Through their wholesale partner, $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food. They’re serving around 340 families a week right now and the shelves are the lowest Denise has seen before Thanksgiving.

Incentives:
$100 — I play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 — chat picks my hair dye color and I do it on stream
$400 — one hour of chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 — I vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry

First half is community lobbies (I’ll drop the code), second half chat votes on the game every 2 hours. No repeat maps, Larry.

Even $3 helps. If you can’t give, absolutely no pressure — watching, sharing the stream, or hanging out is genuinely useful. No card? Canned/boxed food can go in the blue bin by the pantry’s side door Saturdays 9–1, and sharing the link helps too.

Let’s beat last year’s $212 by a lot.

---

To: #general
Replying to: c05

Fair to be skeptical. It is a bit “begging with extra steps,” except the steps are Rook matching the first $100, donations going straight to the pantry with nothing taken off, and me letting chat pick my hair dye. If that’s still cringe, that’s honestly fine — no one has to donate. If you want to help without spending money, sharing the stream or just hopping in the lobbies actually helps too. And Paige, no card is fine — canned/boxed food can go in the blue bin by the pantry’s side door Saturdays 9–1.
